items.name: CAP-001 autónomo
items.reason: CAP-001 exists canonically and a safe planning overlay is integrated, but current main lacks the historical acquisition runtime path. The real gap is to extend the existing CAP-001 through FACT-001/JOB-001 at zero cost rather than creating another acquisition engine.

items.name: Lead discovery
items.reason: Business-entity-first lead discovery planning is deterministic and integrated. Physical source execution remains separately gated and no outreach or CRM write is authorized.

items.name: ICP discovery
items.reason: Firmographic ICP definition and evidence-aware scoring are implemented deterministically, with protected/personal attributes denied. It remains PREPROD logic rather than a PROD autonomous system.

items.name: Lead enrichment waterfall
items.reason: A zero-cost company-first enrichment waterfall exists with provenance and freshness requirements and no guessing of personal contact data. Provider/source execution remains gated.

items.name: Clay patterns
items.reason: Optional connector/pattern source only. CEREBRO does not introduce a mandatory commercial runtime, credits or automatic spend while existing zero-cost routes remain available.

items.name: PhantomBuster benchmark
items.reason: Benchmark only. Automated outreach, CAPTCHA capability and paid runtime dependency are outside this safe zero-cost scope.

items.name: Octoparse fallback
items.reason: Free-local fallback benchmark only. No cloud paid dependency is introduced and CAPTCHA bypass remains forbidden.
